title: lathyrus lanszwertii var. tracyi
intro: Lathyrus lanszwertii var. tracyi, commonly known as Tracy's sweet pea, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help alleviate various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Tracy's sweet pea include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic and antispasmodic effects. Additionally, the plant's therapeutic actions may include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display antimicrobial properties, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and research.
